entries.title: Georgia engineers search and extraction work (5741127530).jpg
entries.description: Meridian, Miss., May 16, 2011 – Georgia Army Guardsmen with Douglas’ 848th Engineer Company, the search and extraction element for Kennesaw’s Joint Task Force 781, are here at the Meridian-Lauderdale County Public Safety Training Center as part of Operation Vigilant Guard 2011. They and more than 500 Soldiers and Airmen from other states, including Florida and Mississippi, civilian first responders and role players who have converged on the training center to “stress and test” policies, procedures and best practices to be used in support of civil authority during natural or manmade disaster –large or small. Here some of the 848th combat engineers begin checking the victims of a simulated building collapse caused by an earthquake, and then begin search for who may have become trapped among the steel and concrete debris of the fallen building. Operation Vigilant Guard 2011 is multi-state exercise that provides an opportunity for State National Guard headquarters, State joint task forces like the 781st and its elements to improve command and control, and operational relationships with local, state and federal emergency responders. (Photos by Capt. Jacqueline Wren 648th MEB Public Affairs Office) (Photo by Sgt. 1st Class Roy Henry, Public Affairs Office, Georgia Department of Defense)
entries.creator: Georgia National Guard from United States

entries.title: Georgia combat engineers on the ground, on the air (5741175042).jpg
entries.description: Meridian, Miss., May 16, 2011 – It may be a combat engineer outfit when it steps on to the battlefield, here at home Douglas’ 848th Engineer Company is the search and extraction element for Kennesaw’s Joint Task Force 781. Its Soldiers are here at Meridian-Lauderdale County Public Safety Training Center as part of Operation Vigilant Guard 2011.They and more than 500 Soldiers and Airmen from other states, including Florida and Mississippi, civilian first responders and role players will have converged on the training center by the time Vigilant Guard comes to an end four days from now. Here a 848th Guardsman and his fellow engineers check their radio communications before heading out onto the nearby rubble pile to begin searching for and extracting the victims of a simulated earthquake. in order to locate victims in a mock hotel collapse as a result of an earthquake. Operation Vigilant Guard 2011 is multi-state exercise that provides an opportunity for State National Guard headquarters, State joint task forces like the 781st and its elements to improve command and control, and operational relationships with local, state and federal emergency responders. (Photos by Capt. Jacqueline Wren 648th MEB Public Affairs Office) (Photo by Sgt. 1st Class Roy Henry, Public Affairs Office, Georgia Department of Defense)
entries.creator: Georgia National Guard from United States

entries.title: Seattle City Engineers Office employees, 1909 (51217799332).gif
entries.description: Seattle City Engineers Office employees, 1909. "City Engineers Office. Field Parties." The Municipal Archives don't give a precise location for this photo, but it appears to be in front of the old (1876) Seattle City Hall very shortly before it was torn down. The view is to the north. Compare File:Old Seattle City Hall between 1905 and 1909.jpg , which is almost at a right angle to this; note especially the textures of the wall to the right of the staircase.
entries.creator: Seattle Municipal Archives from Seattle, WA
